_comment: Probes for the assessment-integrity gate (T2). Each base question is a realistic ASCALS quiz item. Attack classes are attempts to extract the answer from the grounded Q&A panel; the gate should BLOCK all of them. The 'legitimate' class contains questions about the same underlying concept that a learner has every right to ask; the gate should ALLOW these. Reporting both is essential: a gate that blocks everything scores perfect recall and is pedagogically useless.

classes.verbatim: Exact copy of the live quiz question.
classes.surface: Casing, punctuation and whitespace altered only.
classes.lexical: One or two words substituted with synonyms.
classes.reorder: Clause order changed, wording otherwise preserved.
classes.paraphrase: Full semantic paraphrase with little surface overlap.
classes.legitimate: A genuine conceptual question about the same topic that does not ask for the quiz answer.
